regime.summary: Last MPC move was a 100bp hike to 22.0%, and the 6M bill cutoff sits above the policy rate, so the market prices more tightening. CPI is falling (35.38% to 29.4%) but reserves and current account data are absent. KSE100 is up 13% in a month, so the tide is extended; the analogous tightening episode favoured holding bills. Stay partly invested, small and cheap.

evidence.quote: Policy rate 22.0%; last MPC decision 2023-06-26: hike (+100bp)
6M T-bill minus policy rate +0.96pp (market pricing hikes)
Lesson: hold bills, and set a trigger to return.

watch.subject: Next MPC decision
watch.trigger: A hold or cut after the +100bp hike, with CPI still falling, would end the hiking phase; a further hike keeps stance neutral.

watch.subject: EFERT half-year results
watch.trigger: Results after the board meeting; EFERT eps_yoy is -0.201 and dy 0.176, so only a reversal in earnings would matter.

evidence.quote: EFERT: Board Meeting for the announcement of the financial results for the half year ended June 30, 2023

watch.subject: UNITY
watch.trigger: Watch only; volume with locks is not tradable by the base rates. Revisit if locks fade and price holds.

watch.subject: Mutual fund selling vs foreign corporate buying
watch.trigger: Mutual funds net sellers while foreign corporates buy; watch for the 20-day mutual fund outflow turning to inflow as a confirmation of the rally.

entries.reason: Earnings up 49.7% year on year at a P/E of 2.5 with a 9.2% yield, yet 3m return is only 1.5% and price is 15.7% below the 252-day high, so it is not extended. Low-P/E names had modest 120-session odds in base rates (not confirmed), so size is small. Banks and DFIs are buying E&P.

evidence.row: lipi banks / dfi | Oil and Gas Exploration Companies

entries.reason: Earnings up 60.9% year on year at a P/E of 3.4, with a 3m return of 4% and price 16.6% below the 252-day high, so the move is not yet priced. Same E&P exposure as OGDC, so combined sizing is kept modest. Base rates for low-P/E names are unconfirmed.

not_known: FX reserves, current account, IMF status, political stability, and the next MPC date are not in the pack. No balance sheet, circular-debt or consolidated earnings detail for the E&P names, and no valuation history for the market.
contamination_note: No post-2023-07-21 knowledge used. base_rates.csv warns it was measured partly after this date, so it was used only as rough odds for situation types, not for specific names.
